title: Semio Store Graphql Api
description: Replace semio-store JSON-RPC with GraphQL over HTTP, wire native KitStore for backbone commands, add GraphiQL dev config in launch.json.
summary: Fixed `gql_coord3` mapping: `Coordinate` is 2D (u,v) mapped to GqlCoordinate3 (x,y,z) with z=0 so `semio` compiles. Rewrote `semio/store/tests/rpc.rs` to use `kitStore { batch(...) }` (live + backbone) instead of removed `kitCommandShell` API; all 3 integration tests pass. Added VS Code launch `🛠️dev👤semio🏪store📊graphiql` (`cargo run -p semio-store`, `SEMIO_STORE_PORT=4010`, opens GraphiQL in browser on ready). Replaced `semio/store/README.md` and `AGENTS.md` to document HTTP+GraphQL (no stdio JSON-RPC).
